settings.title: How long does each person take?

settings.title: What if someone is uncomfortable on camera?

settings.editor: Most people say that, and most are fine within a minute. Directing people who don't like being photographed is the actual skill in headshots.

settings.title: Can new starters be added later?

settings.editor: Yes. We keep the lighting setup on file so a top-up session matches the original set rather than standing out on the team page.
